title: Action, perception and affect as three gradient flows on free energy

statements.text: With action $M$, perception $\varphi$, prediction $\psi$, inferred world $Q$, prediction error $e = \varphi(M) - \psi(Q)$ and precision $\omega$, free energy is $F = \frac{1}{2} e \cdot \omega \cdot e - \log(\omega)$. A self-evidencing system changes action and inferred world down the gradient of $F$, each in proportion to the precision-weighted error, and changes precision by $\dot{\omega} = \frac{1}{2}(\omega^{-1} - e \cdot e)$. The three flows are action, perception and affect.
